description: Community Library compatibility test. P0 — dependency for hundreds of gameplay mods.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'communitylibrary', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'Community Library present in load order')

assert((function() local entities=Ext.Entity.GetAllEntitiesWithComponent('eoc::character::CharacterComponent'); return type(entities) == 'table' and #entities > 0 end)(), 'loaded-save character entity query executes')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')

assert((function() local event=Ext.ModEvents['BG3SECompat']['CommunityLibrary']; local fired=false; local id=event:Subscribe(function() fired=true end); event:Throw({}); event:Unsubscribe(id); return fired end)(), 'ModEvents roundtrip executes')
notes: Community Library provides shared Lua utilities and a Compatibility Framework. Uses only foundational APIs — low risk.
